stem.text: On the Earth, an object takes time $T_\text{E}$ to fall from rest through a vertical distance $h$.
On the Moon, the same object takes time $T_\text{M}$ to fall from rest through the same vertical distance $h$.
The ratio $\dfrac{\text{acceleration of free fall on the Earth}}{\text{acceleration of free fall on the Moon}}$ is equal to $6$.
Air resistance is negligible for the object on the Earth and on the Moon.
